claim: Hardware row: 'Mini PC host (Beelink EQi13 class)... $539 list on Beelink's US store; the Frigate doc author's N100-class Beelink EQ13 was reported around $249.99 on pre-order'
problem: The $539 figure is confirmed on the cited Beelink product page ($539.00, struck from $689.00). The secondary $249.99 EQ13 pre-order figure is not on the cited Frigate hardware page any more: the page text mentions the EQ13 as the author's current pick and warns about the EQ14, but contains no price, and the term '249' does not appear anywhere in the fetched page. So one price in the row is now unsourced (possibly a stale reading of an earlier revision of the page).
fix: Delete the '$249.99 on pre-order' clause and keep only the confirmed $539 EQi13 list price, or re-cite a dated source that actually prints $249.99. Note that no cost line in the pilot depends on the figure (the pilot budget uses ~$540), so no downstream arithmetic changes.

claim: Rhombus pricing: 'most dome, bullet and fisheye models land at $748-$1,948 all-in'
problem: Loose rather than wrong. The page's dome/bullet/fisheye set runs from $548 (R120: $399 + $149) to $1,948 (R545: $1,799 + $149); six of the eight models are at or above $748, so 'most' holds, but the stated band silently drops the $548 entry point that the row immediately above it quotes.
fix: Say 'dome, bullet and fisheye models span $548-$1,948 all-in, with most at $748-$1,948' so the range matches the page.
